acceptance: A post with mismatched filename/date, missing required frontmatter, or missing toctree entry fails the build with file:line
context: The merged guard (PR #46, hardened in #48) rejects only draft-status markers. Date-format/filename agreement, required blogpost/date/author/tags fields, and toctree membership remain manual per PUBLISHING.md steps 3-4. Raised as L2 blind spots by both follow-up reviewers.
description: Extend converter validation for blog sources: filename-to-date agreement, required frontmatter presence, and blog/index.md toctree coverage. Keep it structural, not editorial.
